The entire Mittag-Leffler weight has beta-integral and decaying weighted evaluation profile, yielding boundedness and compactness by cutoff in output radius plus Montel. A Stirling saddle at k≈x has e^(-2x) sum ~x^(-2gamma-1/2)/(2sqrt(pi)), and the positive-real kernel has leading (m/2)Gamma(2/m)alpha^((m-2)/m)a^(m-2)r^(m-2) exp(alpha a^m r^m). Combining gives H'_gamma~[m²alpha a^(m-2)/(4sqrt(pi))]c^(-2gamma-1/2)r^(m/2-1-2m gamma). Integrating yields HS iff gamma>1/4, all three spatial energy asymptotics, and parameter residue C_(m,1/4)/(2m). Independently recomputed the saddle ratio at x=40,160 (gamma=.2,.45), ~1.00157 and 1.00039, not a proof.
